titulo: DEVO v2 — Casa, sala com profundidade (noite)
prompt: Painted visual novel and RPG background, dark gothic fantasy, highly detailed, cinematic, painterly brushwork with crisp edges. Interior of the Record's small old townhouse living room seen from a high three-quarter camera, the dark herringbone wooden floor clearly visible in perspective and empty in the middle so characters can walk on it, strong depth in three layers. Foreground: a heavy amethyst velvet curtain edge and a tall brass candelabra cut by the frame on the left, slightly out of focus. Middle: a worn amethyst velvet armchair and a round side table with a small brass clock and a stack of black cards, a patterned violet rug. Back wall: an arched wooden front door, a tall gothic window with leaded glass, a black marble fireplace with a gilded mantel clock, a tall bookcase crammed with old books, a small writing desk with a lamp, framed old portraits in shadow. NIGHT: cold violet moonlight falling through the gothic window in a long shaft with floating dust, warm amber glow of the fireplace embers and one desk lamp, candle flames on the candelabra, deep blue-black shadows in the corners, the door closed with a thin line of warm light under it. Palette: deep black, amethyst violet, cobalt night blue, warm amber accents. No people, no text, no letters, no watermark.
negative: text, letters, watermark, logo, blurry, low detail, pixel art, extra fingers, extra limbs
